title: New ways to learn and teach with ChatGPT Work and Codex
evidence_basis: Official product announcement published on the OpenAI newsroom on August 4, 2026.
confirmed_fact: OpenAI launched three new education plugins for ChatGPT Work and Codex, made available to ChatGPT Edu and ChatGPT for Teachers district deployments.
interpretation: OpenAI is shifting its education strategy from open-ended general chat toward structured, pre-configured study and teaching assistants that enforce human control and help close the skill gap between novice and power users.

title: Wispr moves beyond AI dictation with note-taking assistant
evidence_basis: Reporting by Matthew Finnegan for Computerworld based on Wispr product release on August 7, 2026.
confirmed_fact: Wispr launched Wispr Flow Notetaker, a Mac-based AI meeting and conversation assistant that records directly through local device microphones without requiring a bot to join voice or video calls.
interpretation: Local, bot-free meeting capture reflects growing user demand for personal life-admin tools that remove privacy friction and work seamlessly across in-person and digital settings.

title: New Rules for Back to School 2026: Now Comes the Hard Part
evidence_basis: Common Sense Media 2026 Census report (nationally representative sample of 1,204 U.S. youth, published June 2026) and academic studies cited in Psychology Today on August 10, 2026.
confirmed_fact: Drawing on Common Sense Media's 2026 census, 86% of young people have used generative AI, and 85% of young AI users employ it for schoolwork, yet only 52% have received instruction on how to use AI safely and effectively.
interpretation: Generative AI is fully integrated into modern student workflows, making the central challenge not AI restriction, but teaching learners how to use AI as an active study scaffold rather than a substitute for critical cognitive effort.

title: NotebookLM Is Now Gemini Notebook: 2026 Guide
evidence_basis: Product analysis and feature documentation published August 1, 2026, following Google Labs announcements.
confirmed_fact: Google completed its rollout rebranding NotebookLM to Gemini Notebook, integrating a cloud sandbox environment for code execution alongside Studio panel upgrades including prompt-based slide deck revisions, PPTX file exports, mind maps, and 10 custom visual infographic styles.
interpretation: Personal knowledge management tools are evolving from static document summarizers into interactive research environments that turn raw user notes into visually structured study materials grounded in verified source documents.
